agency.name: Bureau for Behavioral Health (BBH), West Virginia Department of Human Services

narrAffiliate.name: West Virginia Alliance of Recovery Residences (WVARR)

narrNote: WVARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list; its site was opened in-run and confirms it certifies residences to the NARR Standard.
notes: BBH moved from DHHR to the new Department of Human Services in the October 2023 cabinet split; bbh.wv.gov is the bureau's live official site (mission page verified in-run) and (304) 558-0627 is its published main number. HELP4WV is the state-funded 24/7 call/chat/text helpline (operated by First Choice Services, staffed largely by peer-support specialists and recovery coaches) — site and number verified in-run. West Virginia's local layer is 13 Comprehensive Behavioral Health Centers (CBHCs) serving regional catchments; no single official CBHC directory URL was verified in-run, so countyDirectory is null rather than guessed. medicaidSud is null: WV operates Medicaid SUD coverage (including an 1115 SUD demonstration via the Bureau for Medical Services), but the program page could not be re-fetched in-run due to a browser fetch rate limit — flagged for a follow-up verification pass.
